title: University Grants Similar Cluster Explorer
goal: Build a standalone D3 web app that visualizes university grant records as a force-clustered bubble chart sized by award amount and colored by sponsor type, paired with a linked sortable grants table and hover details.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s core D3 workflow: force simulation, categorical clustering, legends, tooltips, labels, and linked chart-table selection, but shifts to a new domain and data model.
